diagram_1_phase_plane.title: Phase Plane Dynamics: Limit Cycle Dissipation in Shallow Buffer
diagram_1_phase_plane.description: Demonstrates BBRv1 oscillating in a large chaotic limit cycle (variance 161.6 pkts^2) vs Crown Fusion monotonically spiraling into a single fixed point attractor (variance 0.0000 pkts^2).
diagram_1_phase_plane.mathematical_attractor: Stable node / overdamped focus: lambda_1 = -0.076, lambda_2 = -0.048

diagram_2_dde_trajectory.title: Delay Differential Equation (DDE) State Space Trajectory
diagram_2_dde_trajectory.type: State Trajectory with Delayed Feedback q(t - RTT)
diagram_2_dde_trajectory.description: Visualizes dq(t)/dt = r_pacer(t) - mu - alpha * q(t - tau). Proof that damping ratio zeta = 1.12 > 1.0 (overdamped) completely suppresses delayed resonance overshoot.

diagram_3_sobol_sensitivity.title: Sobol Global Sensitivity Variance Decomposition
diagram_3_sobol_sensitivity.description: Quantifies the variance contribution of each stage to total 6-stage download time.

diagram_4_hmm_topology.title: HMM 3-State Channel Inference Topology
diagram_4_hmm_topology.description: 3 discrete hidden states with continuous Gaussian/Poisson emissions for real-time channel state identification.

diagram_5_pareto_plateau.title: Pareto Optimal Frontier Discrete Neighborhood Robustness Plateau
diagram_5_pareto_plateau.description: Evaluates 729 discrete +/- 1 pkt perturbations proving Crown Fusion is an ultra-wide flat plateau.
